schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A4 (Content Factory wave 16)

entries.vietlish: lose the exam because I did not study
entries.natural: fail the exam because I did not study
entries.sourcePattern: thi rớt -> lose calqued from VN; English uses fail for exams
entries.context: I think I will lose the exam because I did not study at all last night.

entries.vietlish: win the exam and get a scholarship
entries.natural: pass the exam and get a scholarship
entries.sourcePattern: đậu kỳ thi -> win calqued from thi đậu; English uses pass for exams
entries.context: She worked very hard and managed to win the exam and get a scholarship.

entries.vietlish: tell advice to new employees
entries.natural: give advice to new employees
entries.sourcePattern: đưa ra lời khuyên -> tell used instead of give; English collocates give+advice
entries.context: The manager always tries to tell advice to new employees during their first week.

entries.vietlish: present the presentation in front of the board
entries.natural: give a presentation in front of the board
entries.sourcePattern: thuyết trình -> present + presentation is redundant; English uses give a presentation
entries.context: I was nervous when I had to present the presentation in front of the board.

entries.vietlish: open the alarm for six in the morning
entries.natural: set an alarm for six in the morning
entries.sourcePattern: đặt báo thức -> open calqued from mở; English uses set for alarm clocks
entries.context: I always open the alarm for six in the morning so I can exercise before work.

entries.vietlish: open the website to check the price
entries.natural: visit the website to check the price
entries.sourcePattern: mở trang web -> open calqued from mở; English uses go to/visit for websites
entries.context: I tried to open the website to check the price but the page kept loading very slowly.

entries.vietlish: make assignment by myself without help
entries.natural: do my assignment by myself without help
entries.sourcePattern: làm bài tập -> make calqued from làm; English uses do for assignments
entries.context: The teacher told us to make assignment by myself without help from classmates.

entries.vietlish: do a speech at the graduation ceremony
entries.natural: give a speech at the graduation ceremony
entries.sourcePattern: phát biểu -> do calqued from làm; English uses give for speeches
entries.context: She was chosen to do a speech at the graduation ceremony in front of all the parents.

entries.vietlish: register to the university by the deadline
entries.natural: apply to the university by the deadline
entries.sourcePattern: đăng ký vào đại học -> register calqued from đăng ký; English uses apply for university admission
entries.context: He has to register to the university by the deadline or his application will not be considered.

entries.vietlish: spend money for new clothes every month
entries.natural: spend money on new clothes every month
entries.sourcePattern: chi tiền cho quần áo -> for calqued from cho; English uses spend money on something
entries.context: She tends to spend money for new clothes every month and has little left for savings.

entries.vietlish: spend a lot for the holiday trip
entries.natural: spend a lot on the holiday trip
entries.sourcePattern: chi nhiều tiền cho chuyến đi -> for calqued from cho; English uses on with spend
entries.context: They decided to spend a lot for the holiday trip and booked a five-star hotel.

entries.vietlish: get fever after standing in the rain
entries.natural: have a fever after standing in the rain
entries.sourcePattern: bị sốt -> get calqued from bị; English typically uses have a fever (article required)
entries.context: She went home early because she started to get fever after standing in the rain.

entries.vietlish: do the bed before leaving the house
entries.natural: make the bed before leaving the house
entries.sourcePattern: dọn giường -> do calqued from làm/dọn; English uses make the bed
entries.context: My mother always taught me to do the bed before leaving the house each morning.

entries.vietlish: arrange the room before the guests arrive
entries.natural: tidy up the room before the guests arrive
entries.sourcePattern: dọn phòng -> arrange calqued from sắp xếp; English uses tidy up for room cleaning
entries.context: We need to arrange the room before the guests arrive this afternoon.

entries.vietlish: wash hands before eat dinner
entries.natural: wash your hands before eating dinner
entries.sourcePattern: rửa tay trước khi ăn -> wash hands (no possessive) + before eat (bare verb)
entries.context: Mom told the children to wash hands before eat dinner every single night.

entries.vietlish: do haircut at the salon near my house
entries.natural: get a haircut at the salon near my house
entries.sourcePattern: cắt tóc -> do calqued from làm; English uses get a haircut
entries.context: I plan to do haircut at the salon near my house before the Tet holiday.

entries.vietlish: cook water for the instant noodles
entries.natural: boil water for the instant noodles
entries.sourcePattern: đun nước -> cook calqued from nấu; English uses boil for heating water
entries.context: I will cook water for the instant noodles while you get the bowls ready.

entries.vietlish: attend for the company seminar on Friday
entries.natural: attend the company seminar on Friday
entries.sourcePattern: tham dự cuộc hội thảo -> attend for adds extra for; English attend takes a direct object
entries.context: All staff must attend for the company seminar on Friday afternoon.

entries.vietlish: join for the English conversation club
entries.natural: join the English conversation club
entries.sourcePattern: tham gia câu lạc bộ -> join for adds extra for; English join takes a direct object
entries.context: I want to join for the English conversation club that meets on Tuesday evenings.

entries.vietlish: register for the job vacancy at the bank
entries.natural: apply for the job vacancy at the bank
entries.sourcePattern: đăng ký xin việc -> register calqued from đăng ký; English uses apply for jobs
entries.context: He decided to register for the job vacancy at the bank before the closing date.

entries.vietlish: gain salary at the end of each month
entries.natural: receive a salary at the end of each month
entries.sourcePattern: nhận lương -> gain calqued from được; English uses receive or earn for salary
entries.context: She starts her new job next week and will gain salary at the end of each month.

entries.vietlish: ask question to the professor after class
entries.natural: ask the professor a question after class
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi câu hỏi cho thầy -> ask question to calqued from hỏi cho; English uses ask + IO + DO
entries.context: I was too shy to ask question to the professor after class about the assignment.

entries.vietlish: increase vocabulary by reading every day
entries.natural: build vocabulary by reading every day
entries.sourcePattern: tăng vốn từ -> increase calqued from tăng; English uses build/expand/grow for vocabulary
entries.context: The best way to increase vocabulary by reading every day is to write new words in a notebook.

entries.vietlish: win scholarship this semester
entries.natural: receive a scholarship this semester
entries.sourcePattern: được học bổng -> win + no article; English uses receive or win a scholarship with article
entries.context: She studied very hard and managed to win scholarship this semester.

entries.vietlish: raise the hand when you have a question
entries.natural: raise your hand when you have a question
entries.sourcePattern: giơ tay -> raise the hand; English uses possessive pronoun, not definite article
entries.context: The teacher asked students to raise the hand when you have a question.

entries.vietlish: transfer my greetings to your family
entries.natural: please give my regards to your family
entries.sourcePattern: chuyển lời chào -> transfer calqued from chuyển; English uses give/pass on/send regards
entries.context: Before she hung up, she said please transfer my greetings to your family from me.

entries.vietlish: climb mountain on the long weekend
entries.natural: go hiking in the mountains on the long weekend
entries.sourcePattern: leo núi -> climb mountain (no article, wrong frame); English uses go hiking or climb a mountain
entries.context: Our group decided to climb mountain on the long weekend to enjoy the fresh air.

entries.vietlish: study piano for the last two years
entries.natural: learn to play the piano for the last two years
entries.sourcePattern: học đàn -> study piano calqued from học; English uses learn to play the piano
entries.context: She has been trying to study piano for the last two years with a private teacher.

entries.vietlish: rise a child alone after her husband left
entries.natural: raise a child alone after her husband left
entries.sourcePattern: nuôi con -> rise calqued from mọc/lớn; English uses raise for bringing up children
entries.context: She had to rise a child alone after her husband left for work overseas.

entries.vietlish: paint the painting for the art exhibition
entries.natural: create a painting for the art exhibition
entries.sourcePattern: vẽ tranh -> paint + painting is redundant; English uses create/make a painting or just paint
entries.context: She spent three months to paint the painting for the art exhibition at the cultural center.

entries.vietlish: take photo of the graduation class
entries.natural: take a photo of the graduation class
entries.sourcePattern: chụp ảnh -> take photo (no article); English requires take a photo
entries.context: The teacher asked everyone to gather together so she could take photo of the graduation class.

entries.vietlish: beat the deadline by submitting a week early
entries.natural: meet the deadline by submitting a week early
entries.sourcePattern: đáp ứng deadline -> beat misapplied; English uses meet the deadline
entries.context: She managed to beat the deadline by submitting a week early to avoid last-minute stress.

entries.vietlish: hold examination for all first-year students
entries.natural: hold an examination for all first-year students
entries.sourcePattern: tổ chức kỳ thi -> hold examination (no article); English requires hold an examination
entries.context: The faculty decided to hold examination for all first-year students at the end of January.

entries.vietlish: answer the interview at three in the afternoon
entries.natural: attend an interview at three in the afternoon
entries.sourcePattern: dự phỏng vấn -> answer calqued from trả lời; English uses attend or have an interview
entries.context: She is very nervous because she has to answer the interview at three in the afternoon.

entries.vietlish: do a mistake during the important presentation
entries.natural: make a mistake during the important presentation
entries.sourcePattern: phạm lỗi -> do calqued from làm; English uses make a mistake, not do
entries.context: It is very easy to do a mistake during the important presentation if you have not practised.

entries.vietlish: develop skill through regular practice
entries.natural: build skills through regular practice
entries.sourcePattern: phát triển kỹ năng -> develop calqued from phát triển; English more naturally uses build/improve skills
entries.context: The coach said the best way to develop skill through regular practice is to set daily goals.

entries.vietlish: receive the exam result next Friday
entries.natural: get the exam results next Friday
entries.sourcePattern: nhận kết quả thi -> receive calqued from nhận; English more naturally uses get for receiving results
entries.context: We should all receive the exam result next Friday according to the professor's announcement.

entries.vietlish: gain knowledge through reading classic books
entries.natural: acquire knowledge through reading classic books
entries.sourcePattern: thu thập kiến thức -> gain calqued from thu được; acquire is more formal for systematic knowledge-building
entries.context: The professor encouraged students to gain knowledge through reading classic books outside of class.

entries.vietlish: exercise the body three times per week
entries.natural: exercise three times per week
entries.sourcePattern: tập thể dục -> exercise the body (the body is unidiomatic); English exercise is used without body as object
entries.context: The doctor advised him to exercise the body three times per week to improve his heart health.

entries.vietlish: make a salary working at the coffee shop
entries.natural: earn a salary working at the coffee shop
entries.sourcePattern: kiếm lương -> make calqued from làm/kiếm; English uses earn a salary
entries.context: She manages to make a salary working at the coffee shop while finishing her degree.

entries.vietlish: the internet is broken again today
entries.natural: the internet is down again today
entries.sourcePattern: internet hỏng -> broken calqued from hỏng; English uses down for service outages
entries.context: I cannot send the email because the internet is broken again today.

entries.vietlish: my phone out of battery, need to charge
entries.natural: my phone is dead, I need to charge it
entries.sourcePattern: hết pin rồi -> out of battery; copula dropped; English typically says my phone is dead/dying
entries.context: I cannot call you right now because my phone out of battery, need to charge.

entries.vietlish: upload picture up to the group chat
entries.natural: upload a picture to the group chat
entries.sourcePattern: đăng ảnh lên -> up is a redundant direction calqued from lên; English upload already implies upward movement
entries.context: She tried to upload picture up to the group chat but the file was too large.

entries.vietlish: phone memory full, cannot download the app
entries.natural: phone storage is full, I cannot download the app
entries.sourcePattern: bộ nhớ điện thoại đầy -> phone memory calqued; English uses storage for device capacity
entries.context: Phone memory full, cannot download the app I need for the class.

entries.vietlish: add friend on the app to stay in touch
entries.natural: send a friend request on the app to stay in touch
entries.sourcePattern: thêm bạn -> add friend omits the full social-network action of sending a request
entries.context: She told me to add friend on the app to stay in touch after we move to different cities.

entries.vietlish: I done the report, send it now or tomorrow
entries.natural: I have finished the report, should I send it now or tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: Tôi xong báo cáo rồi -> I done; have auxiliary dropped; VN completion marker transferred
entries.context: I done the report, send it now or tomorrow? Please tell me before the end of today.

entries.vietlish: still not arrive yet, the train is late
entries.natural: she still hasn't arrived yet, the train must be late
entries.sourcePattern: vẫn chưa đến -> still not...yet stack calqued from Vietnamese; redundant negation
entries.context: Still not arrive yet, the train is late and everyone is waiting at the station.

entries.vietlish: the soup go cold, reheat it please
entries.natural: the soup has gone cold, please reheat it
entries.sourcePattern: canh nguội rồi -> go cold with no present perfect; completion marker dropped
entries.context: The soup go cold, reheat it please before Dad sits down to eat.

entries.vietlish: too interesting, I forgot to sleep last night
entries.natural: so interesting that I forgot to sleep last night
entries.sourcePattern: thú vị quá -> too used as intensifier; VN quá = too/very/so; English too implies excess
entries.context: The book was too interesting, I forgot to sleep last night and finished the whole thing.

entries.vietlish: too funny, I almost fall from my chair
entries.natural: so funny that I almost fell off my chair
entries.sourcePattern: buồn cười quá -> too used as intensifier not excess; VN quá = intensifier in positive contexts
entries.context: The comedy show was too funny, I almost fall from my chair laughing with my friends.

entries.vietlish: she study hard hard to get the scholarship
entries.natural: she studied really hard to get the scholarship
entries.sourcePattern: học chăm lắm -> reduplication intensifier calqued from Vietnamese
entries.context: Everyone knows she study hard hard to get the scholarship and she deserves it.

entries.vietlish: tomorrow have big exam, very nervous tonight
entries.natural: there is a big exam tomorrow, I am very nervous tonight
entries.sourcePattern: mai có thi lớn -> tomorrow have; existential copula and subject dropped
entries.context: Tomorrow have big exam, very nervous tonight and cannot focus on reviewing my notes.

entries.vietlish: make research on the effects of air pollution
entries.natural: conduct research on the effects of air pollution
entries.sourcePattern: làm nghiên cứu -> make calqued from làm; academic English uses conduct research
entries.context: The university team will make research on the effects of air pollution on children's health.

entries.vietlish: the essay tells about the impact of social media
entries.natural: the essay discusses the impact of social media
entries.sourcePattern: bài văn nói về -> tells about calqued from nói về; academic English uses discuss/explore/examine
entries.context: The essay tells about the impact of social media on the mental health of teenagers.

entries.vietlish: write thesis alone without any guidance
entries.natural: write a thesis alone without any guidance
entries.sourcePattern: viết luận văn -> no article; VN does not use articles before nouns
entries.context: She decided to write thesis alone without any guidance because her supervisor was abroad.

entries.vietlish: practice gym four times a week to stay fit
entries.natural: go to the gym four times a week to stay fit
entries.sourcePattern: tập gym -> practice calqued from tập; English uses go to the gym or work out
entries.context: My brother tries to practice gym four times a week to stay fit for the football season.

entries.vietlish: lift weight every morning before the school run
entries.natural: lift weights every morning before the school run
entries.sourcePattern: tập tạ -> lift weight (singular); English uses lift weights (plural)
entries.context: He gets up at five every morning to lift weight every morning before the school run.

entries.vietlish: go run with my dog in the evening
entries.natural: go running with my dog in the evening
entries.sourcePattern: đi chạy -> go run (bare infinitive); English requires gerund: go running
entries.context: After work I like to go run with my dog in the evening around the park near my house.

entries.vietlish: cut the orange equal so everyone gets a fair share
entries.natural: cut the orange into equal pieces so everyone gets a fair share
entries.sourcePattern: cắt cam bằng nhau -> cut equal; resultative complement calqued without into + noun phrase
entries.context: Dad always makes sure to cut the orange equal so everyone gets a fair share at the table.

entries.vietlish: I go home eat dinner with my family tonight
entries.natural: I am going home to have dinner with my family tonight
entries.sourcePattern: về nhà ăn tối -> go eat; serial verb chain calqued; no preposition or infinitive between them
entries.context: I go home eat dinner with my family tonight so I need to leave the office by six.

entries.vietlish: come eat together, the food is getting cold
entries.natural: come and eat together, the food is getting cold
entries.sourcePattern: lại ăn cùng nhau -> serial verb calqued without and; English requires a conjunction
entries.context: She called everyone to come eat together, the food is getting cold so please hurry.

entries.vietlish: she marry already and move to a new city
entries.natural: she is already married and has moved to a new city
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy lấy chồng rồi -> marry already; completion marker rồi calqued as already; copula dropped
entries.context: I heard that she marry already and move to a new city last year.

entries.vietlish: the room small but very comfortable and bright
entries.natural: the room is small but very comfortable and bright
entries.sourcePattern: phòng nhỏ nhưng tiện nghi -> copula dropped; VN predicative adj does not need is
entries.context: The room small but very comfortable and bright, which is all I need during the trip.

entries.vietlish: today not have any lecture, so I sleep in
entries.natural: there are no lectures today, so I slept in
entries.sourcePattern: hôm nay không có buổi học -> today not have; existential negative calqued
entries.context: Today not have any lecture, so I sleep in until ten and then had a slow breakfast.

entries.vietlish: the ceremony finish already, we can go home
entries.natural: the ceremony has ended, we can go home now
entries.sourcePattern: lễ xong rồi -> finish already; completion marker rồi calqued
entries.context: The ceremony finish already, we can go home and the children are getting very sleepy.

entries.vietlish: I happy when hear you will come to visit
entries.natural: I am happy to hear that you will come to visit
entries.sourcePattern: Tôi vui khi nghe -> I happy when hear; copula and conjunction dropped
entries.context: I happy when hear you will come to visit next month, it has been too long.

entries.vietlish: yesterday not study because feel too tired
entries.natural: I didn't study yesterday because I felt too tired
entries.sourcePattern: hôm qua không học vì mệt -> yesterday not study; subject, do-negation, and past tense all dropped
entries.context: Yesterday not study because feel too tired after the long day at work and the gym.

entries.vietlish: class dismiss already, I am waiting outside
entries.natural: class has been dismissed, I am waiting outside
entries.sourcePattern: tan học rồi -> class dismiss already; passive and present perfect both dropped
entries.context: Class dismiss already, I am waiting outside the building for you to come pick me up.

entries.vietlish: I stay home when rain outside
entries.natural: I stay home when it rains outside
entries.sourcePattern: tôi ở nhà khi mưa -> when rain; dummy subject it and third-person inflection both omitted
entries.context: I stay home when rain outside instead of going to the market on a Saturday like this.

entries.vietlish: she laugh not stop after hearing the story
entries.natural: she could not stop laughing after hearing the story
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy cười không dứt -> laugh not stop; serial negation calqued from Vietnamese structure
entries.context: She laugh not stop after hearing the story and had to cover her mouth to calm down.

entries.vietlish: he still not answer my message after two days
entries.natural: he still hasn't answered my message after two days
entries.sourcePattern: vẫn chưa trả lời -> still not + base form; present perfect dropped
entries.context: He still not answer my message after two days and I am starting to feel worried.

entries.vietlish: the exam result come out next Monday for sure
entries.natural: the exam results will come out next Monday for sure
entries.sourcePattern: kết quả thi ra thứ hai -> result come out; future tense not marked
entries.context: The exam result come out next Monday for sure so we just have to wait and stay calm.

entries.vietlish: let we go to the beach this Saturday together
entries.natural: let us go to the beach this Saturday together
entries.sourcePattern: chúng ta đi biển -> let we; subjective pronoun we used instead of us
entries.context: Let we go to the beach this Saturday together and forget about work for one day.

entries.vietlish: I not feel comfortable with loud music at night
entries.natural: I don't feel comfortable with loud music at night
entries.sourcePattern: Tôi không cảm thấy thoải mái -> I not feel; do-negation dropped
entries.context: I not feel comfortable with loud music at night and always ask my neighbors politely.

entries.vietlish: the weather today very hot, better stay inside
entries.natural: the weather is very hot today, we had better stay inside
entries.sourcePattern: thời tiết hôm nay rất nóng -> copula dropped; adverb today precedes adjective calqued
entries.context: The weather today very hot, better stay inside and drink plenty of cold water.

entries.vietlish: where you go after work every day
entries.natural: where do you go after work every day
entries.sourcePattern: bạn đi đâu sau khi làm -> where you go; do-support and subject-aux inversion omitted
entries.context: I am curious — where you go after work every day, you always leave so quickly.

entries.vietlish: why she not come to the party yesterday
entries.natural: why didn't she come to the party yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: tại sao cô ấy không đến -> why she not come; do-support and inversion both omitted
entries.context: Why she not come to the party yesterday? She said she would be there for sure.

entries.vietlish: how long you wait for the result
entries.natural: how long have you been waiting for the result
entries.sourcePattern: bạn chờ bao lâu rồi -> how long you wait; perfect aspect and inversion dropped
entries.context: How long you wait for the result? It has been almost three weeks since the interview.

entries.vietlish: you know what time the pharmacy close today
entries.natural: do you know what time the pharmacy closes today
entries.sourcePattern: bạn biết mấy giờ nhà thuốc đóng cửa -> embedded question with no do-support frame
entries.context: Excuse me, you know what time the pharmacy close today? I need to get there before dinner.

entries.vietlish: what mean this word in English
entries.natural: what does this word mean in English
entries.sourcePattern: từ này có nghĩa là gì -> what mean; do-support and inversion omitted in wh-question
entries.context: Can you help me? What mean this word in English? I saw it in the book but cannot find it.

entries.vietlish: she made me to feel very embarrassed
entries.natural: she made me feel very embarrassed
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy khiến tôi cảm thấy xấu hổ -> made + to + infinitive; causative takes bare infinitive
entries.context: She made me to feel very embarrassed in front of everyone when she said that.

entries.vietlish: I want you help me write the introduction
entries.natural: I want you to help me write the introduction
entries.sourcePattern: tôi muốn bạn giúp tôi -> want + you + bare verb; infinitive marker to omitted
entries.context: I want you help me write the introduction to my report because I always struggle with openings.

entries.vietlish: I suggest us to leave the venue early
entries.natural: I suggest we leave the venue early
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đề nghị chúng ta rời đi -> suggest + us + to + infinitive; suggest takes that-clause or bare gerund
entries.context: I suggest us to leave the venue early so we can avoid the traffic jam after the concert.

entries.vietlish: they let her to choose her own schedule
entries.natural: they let her choose her own schedule
entries.sourcePattern: họ để cô ấy tự chọn -> let + her + to + infinitive; let takes bare infinitive not to-infinitive
entries.context: The new company is very flexible and they let her to choose her own schedule each week.

entries.vietlish: the man stand at the door is our new director
entries.natural: the man standing at the door is our new director
entries.sourcePattern: người đàn ông đứng ở cửa -> stand used as attributive verb without participial -ing form
entries.context: Look over there — the man stand at the door is our new director who just flew in.

entries.vietlish: the student who yesterday received the prize is very humble
entries.natural: the student who received the prize yesterday is very humble
entries.sourcePattern: học sinh ngày hôm qua nhận giải -> time adverb placed inside relative clause before verb
entries.context: The student who yesterday received the prize is very humble and donated it to charity.

entries.vietlish: I have a problem want to discuss with you
entries.natural: I have a problem I want to discuss with you
entries.sourcePattern: tôi có một vấn đề muốn nói với bạn -> relative clause without pronoun who/that
entries.context: I have a problem want to discuss with you after the meeting if you have a moment.

entries.vietlish: she told me not come before eight
entries.natural: she told me not to come before eight
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy bảo tôi đừng đến trước tám giờ -> negative infinitive not come; to required
entries.context: She told me not come before eight because she will not be home until then.

entries.vietlish: she is taller as her older sister
entries.natural: she is taller than her older sister
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy cao hơn chị gái -> taller as; hơn -> as by analogy with so...as constructions
entries.context: Everyone is surprised that she is taller as her older sister by almost five centimetres.

entries.vietlish: he is the most hard-working person in the office
entries.natural: he is the hardest-working person in the office
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy là người chăm chỉ nhất -> most + compound adjective; -est suffix required instead
entries.context: Everyone agrees that he is the most hard-working person in the office and deserves a bonus.

entries.vietlish: between you and I, she is planning to resign
entries.natural: between you and me, she is planning to resign
entries.sourcePattern: giữa bạn và tôi -> between + subjective pronoun I; object pronoun me required after preposition
entries.context: Between you and I, she is planning to resign next month and they don't know yet.

entries.vietlish: he told to me the news about the new project
entries.natural: he told me the news about the new project
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy nói với tôi -> told to me; tell takes indirect object without to
entries.context: He told to me the news about the new project but asked me to keep it confidential.

entries.vietlish: please remind me bring my umbrella tomorrow
entries.natural: please remind me to bring my umbrella tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: nhắc tôi mang ô ngày mai -> remind + me + bare verb; remind requires to-infinitive
entries.context: Please remind me bring my umbrella tomorrow because the forecast says heavy rain.

entries.vietlish: I saw her ran very fast past the security gate
entries.natural: I saw her run very fast past the security gate
entries.sourcePattern: tôi thấy cô ấy chạy -> perception verb + past tense form; bare infinitive required after see
entries.context: I saw her ran very fast past the security gate and thought something must be wrong.

entries.vietlish: she asked me how old am I when we first met
entries.natural: she asked me how old I was when we first met
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy hỏi tôi bao nhiêu tuổi -> indirect question retains interrogative word order
entries.context: She asked me how old am I when we first met at the language exchange event.

entries.vietlish: can you tell me where is the nearest bus stop
entries.natural: can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có thể cho tôi biết trạm xe buýt gần nhất ở đâu -> embedded question retains inversion
entries.context: Excuse me, can you tell me where is the nearest bus stop? I am new to this area.

entries.vietlish: do you know when will the next class begin
entries.natural: do you know when the next class will begin
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có biết lớp học tiếp theo bắt đầu khi nào -> embedded question retains subject-aux inversion
entries.context: Do you know when will the next class begin? I lost track of the schedule this week.

entries.vietlish: I wonder how does she always look so calm
entries.natural: I wonder how she always looks so calm
entries.sourcePattern: tôi tự hỏi cô ấy làm thế nào luôn trông bình tĩnh -> embedded question retains inversion after wonder
entries.context: I wonder how does she always look so calm even during the most stressful presentations.

entries.vietlish: please tell me what should I write in the subject line
entries.natural: please tell me what I should write in the subject line
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi biết tôi nên viết gì -> embedded question retains interrogative word order after tell
entries.context: Please tell me what should I write in the subject line when sending an email to the client.

entries.vietlish: we will tomorrow announce the winner of the contest
entries.natural: we will announce the winner of the contest tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: chúng ta sẽ thông báo ngày mai -> adverb tomorrow placed between aux and main verb
entries.context: We will tomorrow announce the winner of the contest, so please check your email in the morning.

entries.vietlish: she already has submitted the report to her supervisor
entries.natural: she has already submitted the report to her supervisor
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy đã nộp báo cáo rồi -> already placed before has; adverb should follow auxiliary
entries.context: She already has submitted the report to her supervisor before the official deadline.

entries.vietlish: I always am available to help my classmates
entries.natural: I am always available to help my classmates
entries.sourcePattern: tôi luôn luôn sẵn sàng -> frequency adverb always placed before be instead of after
entries.context: I always am available to help my classmates with their studies if they need extra support.

entries.vietlish: never I have tasted such delicious pho as this one
entries.natural: I have never tasted such delicious pho as this one
entries.sourcePattern: chưa bao giờ tôi ăn -> negative adverb never at sentence start without subject-aux inversion
entries.context: Never I have tasted such delicious pho as this one, it is better than any restaurant I know.

entries.vietlish: the report which I yesterday sent to you needs corrections
entries.natural: the report that I sent to you yesterday needs corrections
entries.sourcePattern: báo cáo mà tôi hôm qua gửi -> adverb yesterday placed inside relative clause before verb
entries.context: The report which I yesterday sent to you needs corrections in the second chapter.

entries.vietlish: it is very difficult the advanced grammar to understand
entries.natural: it is very difficult to understand the advanced grammar
entries.sourcePattern: nó rất khó để hiểu ngữ pháp -> extraposition error; to-infinitive phrase displaced
entries.context: For most beginners, it is very difficult the advanced grammar to understand without a good teacher.

entries.vietlish: she kind and very helpful so all her colleagues love her
entries.natural: she is kind and very helpful so all her colleagues love her
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy tốt bụng và hữu ích -> copula is dropped; predicate adjective used without be
entries.context: She kind and very helpful so all her colleagues love her and come to her for advice.

entries.vietlish: how much cost this leather jacket in the sale
entries.natural: how much does this leather jacket cost in the sale
entries.sourcePattern: cái áo khoác này giá bao nhiêu -> how much cost; do-support and inversion omitted
entries.context: Excuse me, how much cost this leather jacket in the sale? The tag seems to be missing.

entries.vietlish: my pronunciation not enough good to get a high score
entries.natural: my pronunciation is not good enough to get a high score
entries.sourcePattern: phát âm không đủ tốt -> not enough good; enough placed before adjective; English requires adj + enough
entries.context: My pronunciation not enough good to get a high score, so I practise every single morning.

entries.vietlish: let her to make her own decision about the future
entries.natural: let her make her own decision about the future
entries.sourcePattern: để cô ấy tự quyết định -> let + her + to + infinitive; let takes bare infinitive
entries.context: Her parents decided to let her to make her own decision about the future career path.

entries.vietlish: she feel bore sitting at home with nothing to do
entries.natural: she feels bored sitting at home with nothing to do
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy cảm thấy chán -> feel bore; participial adjective bored reduced to bare base form
entries.context: She feel bore sitting at home with nothing to do during the long holiday break.

entries.vietlish: are you convenient to meet on Thursday afternoon
entries.natural: are you free to meet on Thursday afternoon
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có rảnh không -> are you convenient; rảnh = free/available; convenient applies to things not people
entries.context: Hi, are you convenient to meet on Thursday afternoon to discuss the project?

entries.vietlish: an advice from my mother changed my life
entries.natural: a piece of advice from my mother changed my life
entries.sourcePattern: một lời khuyên -> an advice; advice is uncountable in English; requires a piece of advice
entries.context: An advice from my mother changed my life when I was deciding which career to pursue.

entries.vietlish: a furniture was delivered to the new apartment
entries.natural: a piece of furniture was delivered to the new apartment
entries.sourcePattern: một món đồ nội thất -> a furniture; furniture is uncountable; requires a piece of furniture
entries.context: A furniture was delivered to the new apartment but the delivery team left without assembling it.

entries.vietlish: an important information was shared in the meeting
entries.natural: important information was shared in the meeting
entries.sourcePattern: một thông tin quan trọng -> an important information; information is uncountable
entries.context: An important information was shared in the meeting but not everyone was present to hear it.

entries.vietlish: he accepted to participate in the workshop
entries.natural: he agreed to participate in the workshop
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy đồng ý -> accepted to; đồng ý = agree; accept + to-infinitive is unidiomatic in this sense
entries.context: He accepted to participate in the workshop after the organiser explained the benefits.

entries.vietlish: she is very sympathy toward people who struggle
entries.natural: she is very sympathetic toward people who struggle
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy rất đồng cảm -> is very sympathy; sympathy is a noun; sympathetic is the adjective form
entries.context: She is very sympathy toward people who struggle, which is why she became a social worker.

entries.vietlish: he is very economic when it comes to spending
entries.natural: he is very economical when it comes to spending
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy rất tiết kiệm -> is very economic; economic relates to the economy; economical means thrifty
entries.context: He is very economic when it comes to spending and always compares prices before buying anything.

entries.vietlish: the historic novel was set during the French colonial era
entries.natural: the historical novel was set during the French colonial era
entries.sourcePattern: cuốn tiểu thuyết lịch sử -> historic novel; historical describes things relating to history; historic = of great significance
entries.context: The historic novel was set during the French colonial era and won a major national prize.

entries.vietlish: she make a progress every time she practises speaking
entries.natural: she makes progress every time she practises speaking
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy tạo ra sự tiến bộ -> make a progress; progress is uncountable; requires make progress
entries.context: She make a progress every time she practises speaking English with her foreign friends.

entries.vietlish: a homework is due first thing Monday morning
entries.natural: homework is due first thing Monday morning
entries.sourcePattern: một bài tập -> a homework; homework is an uncountable noun in English
entries.context: A homework is due first thing Monday morning so I have to finish it before the weekend ends.

entries.vietlish: an equipment is needed to complete the experiment
entries.natural: a piece of equipment is needed to complete the experiment
entries.sourcePattern: một thiết bị -> an equipment; equipment is uncountable; requires a piece of equipment
entries.context: An equipment is needed to complete the experiment but the lab does not have one available.

entries.vietlish: she arrived at the airport with a lot of luggages
entries.natural: she arrived at the airport with a lot of luggage
entries.sourcePattern: nhiều hành lý -> a lot of luggages; luggage is uncountable; no plural form
entries.context: She arrived at the airport with a lot of luggages and had to pay an overweight fee.

entries.vietlish: the researches show that sleep affects memory
entries.natural: research shows that sleep affects memory
entries.sourcePattern: những nghiên cứu -> the researches; research is uncountable in this collective sense
entries.context: The researches show that sleep affects memory and concentration during the school day.

entries.vietlish: I received a good news from the embassy today
entries.natural: I received good news from the embassy today
entries.sourcePattern: một tin vui -> a good news; news is uncountable in English
entries.context: I received a good news from the embassy today — my visa application has been approved!

entries.vietlish: can you give me an advice about the job offer
entries.natural: can you give me some advice about the job offer
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi một lời khuyên -> an advice; advice is uncountable; some advice or a piece of advice
entries.context: Can you give me an advice about the job offer? I cannot decide between the two positions.

entries.vietlish: she has a great knowledge of traditional medicine
entries.natural: she has great knowledge of traditional medicine
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy có kiến thức sâu rộng -> a great knowledge; knowledge in this generic sense is uncountable
entries.context: She has a great knowledge of traditional medicine thanks to years of studying with local healers.

entries.vietlish: my uncle has a great experience in project management
entries.natural: my uncle has extensive experience in project management
entries.sourcePattern: chú tôi có kinh nghiệm phong phú -> a great experience; experience as accumulated skill is uncountable
entries.context: My uncle has a great experience in project management so I always ask him for guidance.

entries.vietlish: we need a permission to access the restricted area
entries.natural: we need permission to access the restricted area
entries.sourcePattern: chúng ta cần sự cho phép -> a permission; permission in the general sense is uncountable
entries.context: We need a permission to access the restricted area so let me email the security office.

entries.vietlish: she does a travel every summer to recharge
entries.natural: she takes a trip every summer to recharge
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy đi du lịch -> does a travel; travel in this sense is a verb or uncountable noun; trip is the count noun
entries.context: She does a travel every summer to recharge and comes back full of new energy.

entries.vietlish: I need a training before I can use the new system
entries.natural: I need training before I can use the new system
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cần khóa đào tạo -> a training; training as a skill-building process is uncountable
entries.context: I need a training before I can use the new system so please schedule it as soon as possible.

entries.vietlish: he shared his knowledges with the whole team
entries.natural: he shared his knowledge with the whole team
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy chia sẻ kiến thức -> his knowledges; knowledge is uncountable and has no plural form
entries.context: He shared his knowledges with the whole team during the Friday afternoon workshop.

entries.vietlish: we need some specific trainings for the new hires
entries.natural: we need specific training sessions for the new hires
entries.sourcePattern: chúng ta cần một số đợt đào tạo -> some trainings; training is uncountable; training sessions required
entries.context: We need some specific trainings for the new hires before they start on the front desk.

entries.vietlish: I have many progresses in my IELTS preparation
entries.natural: I have made a lot of progress in my IELTS preparation
entries.sourcePattern: tôi có nhiều tiến bộ -> many progresses; progress is uncountable; no plural form
entries.context: I have many progresses in my IELTS preparation this month and scored six in the last mock test.

entries.vietlish: please be sensible when discussing emotional topics in class
entries.natural: please be sensitive when discussing emotional topics in class
entries.sourcePattern: hãy nhạy cảm -> be sensible; nhạy cảm = sensitive; sensible means practical/reasonable, not emotionally aware
entries.context: The counsellor asked everyone to please be sensible when discussing emotional topics in class.

entries.vietlish: the teacher used an imaginary approach to explain grammar
entries.natural: the teacher used an imaginative approach to explain grammar
entries.sourcePattern: phương pháp sáng tạo -> imaginary approach; imaginary = not real; imaginative = creative
entries.context: The students loved it because the teacher used an imaginary approach to explain grammar using stories.

entries.vietlish: can you give a comprehensive explanation for beginners
entries.natural: can you give a comprehensible explanation for beginners
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích dễ hiểu -> comprehensive explanation; comprehensive = thorough; comprehensible = understandable
entries.context: Can you give a comprehensive explanation for beginners? They find your technical terms confusing.

entries.vietlish: she listens to classic music to relax after work
entries.natural: she listens to classical music to relax after work
entries.sourcePattern: nhạc cổ điển -> classic music; classical = of the formal Western tradition; classic = timeless/enduring
entries.context: She listens to classic music to relax after work and says it helps her sleep better.

entries.vietlish: the nervous winner walked up to receive the trophy
entries.natural: the excited winner walked up to receive the trophy
entries.sourcePattern: hồi hộp -> nervous; VN hồi hộp covers both nervous and excited; positive anticipation context here
entries.context: The nervous winner walked up to receive the trophy with a huge smile on her face.

entries.vietlish: I will do an improvement to the draft before sending
entries.natural: I will make an improvement to the draft before sending
entries.sourcePattern: làm cải tiến -> do an improvement; English collocates make with improvement, not do
entries.context: I will do an improvement to the draft before sending it to the manager for approval.

entries.vietlish: the lab ordered new equipments for the biology department
entries.natural: the lab ordered new equipment for the biology department
entries.sourcePattern: thiết bị mới -> new equipments; equipment is uncountable and has no plural form
entries.context: The lab ordered new equipments for the biology department to run the latest experiments.

entries.vietlish: the company accepted our proposal without any changes
entries.natural: the company approved our proposal without any changes
entries.sourcePattern: công ty chấp thuận -> accepted; chấp thuận = approve; accept here would mean receive, approve means formally endorse
entries.context: The company accepted our proposal without any changes so we can begin the project next week.

entries.vietlish: I need a feedback from you before I finalise the report
entries.natural: I need some feedback from you before I finalise the report
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cần phản hồi -> a feedback; feedback is uncountable; requires some feedback or feedback
entries.context: I need a feedback from you before I finalise the report so please review it tonight.

entries.vietlish: the workshop will eventually finish at five as planned
entries.natural: the workshop will finally finish at five as planned
entries.sourcePattern: cuối cùng -> eventually; eventually implies gradual/unexpected; finally signals the anticipated end
entries.context: The workshop will eventually finish at five as planned, so please do not leave early.

entries.vietlish: she is very sensitive about saving electricity at home
entries.natural: she is very careful about saving electricity at home
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy rất chú ý tiết kiệm điện -> sensitive about saving; sensitive here is a false calque; careful/conscious is more natural
entries.context: She is very sensitive about saving electricity at home and always unplugs all devices before leaving.

entries.vietlish: a luggage was accidentally left on the overnight train
entries.natural: a piece of luggage was accidentally left on the overnight train
entries.sourcePattern: một kiện hành lý -> a luggage; luggage is uncountable; a piece of luggage or a bag
entries.context: A luggage was accidentally left on the overnight train and the owner had to report it to lost property.

entries.vietlish: play computer at home all evening
entries.natural: use the computer at home all evening
entries.sourcePattern: chơi máy tính -> play computer; chơi = play, but play applies to games, not devices in English
entries.context: He spent the whole time to play computer at home all evening instead of doing his homework.

entries.vietlish: say bad mouth about the manager behind her back
entries.natural: talk badly about the manager behind her back
entries.sourcePattern: nói xấu -> say bad mouth; nói xấu = say bad things; English uses talk badly about or badmouth
entries.context: It is very unprofessional to say bad mouth about the manager behind her back at work.

entries.vietlish: drink sweet water after running in the heat
entries.natural: have a soft drink after running in the heat
entries.sourcePattern: uống nước ngọt -> drink sweet water; nước ngọt = soft drink/soda; literal word-for-word translation
entries.context: She likes to drink sweet water after running in the heat even though it is not that healthy.

entries.vietlish: I finish eat, now I will wash the dishes
entries.natural: I have finished eating, now I will wash the dishes
entries.sourcePattern: tôi ăn xong rồi -> finish eat; xong = completion; present perfect and gerund both dropped
entries.context: I finish eat, now I will wash the dishes and then we can watch a film together.

entries.vietlish: push bicycle to school every single morning
entries.natural: ride a bicycle to school every single morning
entries.sourcePattern: đạp xe -> push bicycle; đạp = to pedal/kick; learners translate đạp as push rather than ride
entries.context: She used to push bicycle to school every single morning before her family bought a motorbike.

entries.vietlish: I feel happy in heart when I hear that news
entries.natural: I feel joy in my heart when I hear that news
entries.sourcePattern: vui trong lòng -> happy in heart; lòng = heart/chest; possessive dropped
entries.context: I feel happy in heart when I hear that news about her recovery, truly wonderful.

entries.vietlish: his mind is too narrow to accept new ideas
entries.natural: he is too narrow-minded to accept new ideas
entries.sourcePattern: đầu óc hẹp hòi -> his mind is narrow; narrow-mindedness is a compound adjective in English
entries.context: His mind is too narrow to accept new ideas so the team finds it hard to innovate.

entries.vietlish: she made him lose his face in front of colleagues
entries.natural: she made him lose face in front of his colleagues
entries.sourcePattern: làm anh ấy mất mặt -> lose his face; lose face is an established phrase; his is the transfer error
entries.context: She made him lose his face in front of colleagues by correcting him harshly in the meeting.

entries.vietlish: her mouth is too sweet, everyone loves talking to her
entries.natural: she is a sweet talker, everyone loves talking to her
entries.sourcePattern: miệng ngọt -> mouth is sweet; miệng ngọt = flattering/charming speech; literally transferred
entries.context: Her mouth is too sweet, everyone loves talking to her and she always knows what to say.

entries.vietlish: cut the paper to small pieces for the art project
entries.natural: cut the paper into small pieces for the art project
entries.sourcePattern: cắt giấy thành từng mảnh nhỏ -> cut to small pieces; thành = into; resultative complement with wrong preposition
entries.context: The teacher asked everyone to cut the paper to small pieces for the art project this afternoon.

entries.vietlish: if it will rain tomorrow, I stay at home
entries.natural: if it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home
entries.sourcePattern: nếu trời mưa ngày mai -> if + will; VN does not distinguish conditional mood; will appears in both clauses
entries.context: If it will rain tomorrow, I stay at home and catch up on the reading I missed this week.

entries.vietlish: after finish the assignment I go to the gym
entries.natural: after finishing the assignment I will go to the gym
entries.sourcePattern: sau khi làm xong bài tập -> after finish; VN temporal clause uses bare verb after sau khi
entries.context: After finish the assignment I go to the gym and meet up with my friends for dinner.

entries.vietlish: when arrive at the station, send me a message
entries.natural: when you arrive at the station, send me a message
entries.sourcePattern: khi đến ga -> when arrive; VN omits explicit subject in subordinate clauses
entries.context: When arrive at the station, send me a message and I will come down to meet you outside.

entries.vietlish: before leave the office, turn off the computer
entries.natural: before you leave the office, turn off the computer
entries.sourcePattern: trước khi rời văn phòng -> before leave; VN omits subject in subordinate temporal clauses
entries.context: The last person should before leave the office, turn off the computer and lock the door.

entries.vietlish: the bigger the house, the expensive the monthly rent
entries.natural: the bigger the house, the more expensive the monthly rent
entries.sourcePattern: nhà càng to tiền thuê càng đắt -> the bigger...the expensive; parallel comparative requires more + adj
entries.context: The bigger the house, the expensive the monthly rent, so choose wisely based on your budget.

entries.vietlish: fill the blank with the correct verb form
entries.natural: fill in the blank with the correct verb form
entries.sourcePattern: điền vào chỗ trống -> fill the blank; vào = into; English requires the particle in: fill in the blank
entries.context: The teacher asked us to fill the blank with the correct verb form in each sentence.

entries.vietlish: she explains the topic very detail for all students
entries.natural: she explains the topic in great detail for all students
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích rất chi tiết -> very detail; chi tiết = detail (noun); English uses in detail or in great detail
entries.context: She explains the topic very detail for all students so that even beginners can understand.

entries.vietlish: she speaks English very smooth without hesitation
entries.natural: she speaks English very smoothly without hesitation
entries.sourcePattern: nói tiếng Anh rất trơn tru -> very smooth; trơn tru = smooth (adj); adverb form smoothly required
entries.context: She speaks English very smooth without hesitation, which really impresses her foreign colleagues.

entries.vietlish: I am very anger because of what he said
entries.natural: I am very angry because of what he said
entries.sourcePattern: tôi rất tức giận -> am very anger; tức giận = anger (noun); adjective angry required
entries.context: I am very anger because of what he said in the meeting in front of all the other staff.

entries.vietlish: he is very tired physical after the long flight
entries.natural: he is very physically tired after the long flight
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy mệt thể chất -> tired physical; thể chất = physical (adj); adverb physically required
entries.context: He is very tired physical after the long flight and needs at least one full day to recover.

entries.vietlish: the new policy is announce on the company website
entries.natural: the new policy was announced on the company website
entries.sourcePattern: chính sách mới được thông báo -> is announce; passive formed with base verb instead of past participle
entries.context: The new policy is announce on the company website and all staff must read it carefully.

entries.vietlish: I am very satisfy with the service at this hotel
entries.natural: I am very satisfied with the service at this hotel
entries.sourcePattern: tôi rất hài lòng -> am very satisfy; hài lòng mapped to satisfy (base form); satisfied is required
entries.context: I am very satisfy with the service at this hotel and will definitely recommend it to my friends.

entries.vietlish: the project is delay because of bad weather conditions
entries.natural: the project is delayed because of bad weather conditions
entries.sourcePattern: dự án bị trì hoãn -> is delay; passive formed with base verb; past participle delayed required
entries.context: The project is delay because of bad weather conditions and will not resume until next month.

entries.vietlish: I am very confuse about the new exam format
entries.natural: I am very confused about the new exam format
entries.sourcePattern: tôi rất bối rối -> am very confuse; confuse is the verb; confused is the participial adjective
entries.context: I am very confuse about the new exam format and need the teacher to explain it one more time.

entries.vietlish: the meeting is postpone to next Tuesday morning
entries.natural: the meeting is postponed to next Tuesday morning
entries.sourcePattern: cuộc họp bị hoãn -> is postpone; passive needs past participle postponed not base form
entries.context: The meeting is postpone to next Tuesday morning because the director is travelling overseas.

entries.vietlish: she is very motivate to study after the inspiring talk
entries.natural: she is very motivated to study after the inspiring talk
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy rất có động lực -> is very motivate; motivate is the verb; motivated is the past participial adjective
entries.context: She is very motivate to study after the inspiring talk from the successful alumni last week.

entries.vietlish: he is frustrate because he cannot solve the problem
entries.natural: he is frustrated because he cannot solve the problem
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy thất vọng/bực bội -> is frustrate; frustrate is the verb; frustrated is the participial adjective
entries.context: He is frustrate because he cannot solve the problem and has been stuck on it for two hours.

entries.vietlish: they are excite about going on the school camping trip
entries.natural: they are excited about going on the school camping trip
entries.sourcePattern: các em rất hứng thú -> are excite; excite is the verb; excited is the participial adjective
entries.context: They are excite about going on the school camping trip scheduled for the end of this month.

entries.vietlish: I am please with the progress you have made
entries.natural: I am pleased with the progress you have made
entries.sourcePattern: tôi hài lòng -> am please; please is the verb; pleased is the participial adjective
entries.context: I am please with the progress you have made and look forward to the final result.

entries.vietlish: the room is organize in a very efficient way
entries.natural: the room is organized in a very efficient way
entries.sourcePattern: phòng được sắp xếp -> is organize; passive requires past participle organized
entries.context: The room is organize in a very efficient way and every item has its own labelled place.

entries.vietlish: the news is shock for the whole community
entries.natural: the news is shocking for the whole community
entries.sourcePattern: tin tức gây sốc -> is shock; shock is the verb; shocking is the present participial adjective
entries.context: The news is shock for the whole community and many people gathered to discuss it.

entries.vietlish: she is tire after a long day of teaching
entries.natural: she is tired after a long day of teaching
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy mệt -> is tire; tire is the verb; tired is the past participial adjective
entries.context: She is tire after a long day of teaching and went straight to bed when she got home.

entries.vietlish: I am very amaze at how fast she improved
entries.natural: I am very amazed at how fast she improved
entries.sourcePattern: tôi rất kinh ngạc -> am very amaze; amaze is the verb; amazed is the participial adjective
entries.context: I am very amaze at how fast she improved her English after only six months of practice.

entries.vietlish: the audience is bore with the long and slow lecture
entries.natural: the audience is bored with the long and slow lecture
entries.sourcePattern: khán giả chán -> is bore; bore is the verb; bored is the participial adjective
entries.context: The audience is bore with the long and slow lecture and many people started checking their phones.

entries.vietlish: she feel very bore during the three-hour waiting time
entries.natural: she felt very bored during the three-hour waiting time
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy cảm thấy rất chán -> feel very bore; bore is the verb; bored is the participial adjective
entries.context: She feel very bore during the three-hour waiting time at the airport and finished two chapters of her book.

entries.vietlish: please revert to me at your earliest convenience
entries.natural: please get back to me when you can
entries.sourcePattern: vui lòng phản hồi sớm -> revert to me; Southeast Asian business-English calque; revert = reply only in this usage
entries.context: Please revert to me at your earliest convenience regarding the meeting schedule for next week.

entries.vietlish: I take this opportunity to sincerely thank you
entries.natural: thank you so much for your help
entries.sourcePattern: nhân dịp này tôi xin chân thành cảm ơn -> Confucian ceremonial opener transferred into casual email
entries.context: I take this opportunity to sincerely thank you for all the support during my time here.

entries.vietlish: good morning teacher, how are you today
entries.natural: good morning everyone
entries.sourcePattern: Chào thầy/cô -> teacher used as a direct address form in English; English uses name or role title
entries.context: As she walked into the room she said good morning teacher, how are you today to the whole class.

entries.vietlish: dear teacher, I write to ask about the homework
entries.natural: hi [Name], I wanted to ask about the homework
entries.sourcePattern: Kính thầy/cô -> formal letter opening used in a casual email; register-channel mismatch
entries.context: Dear teacher, I write to ask about the homework. Is it due this Friday or next Monday?

entries.vietlish: I beg your kind understanding and forgiveness for the delay
entries.natural: I apologise for the delay
entries.sourcePattern: kính mong thầy cô thông cảm và tha lỗi -> Confucian deference register transferred; over-apologetic in EN
entries.context: I beg your kind understanding and forgiveness for the delay in submitting my assignment.

entries.vietlish: please kindly assist me in completing this official form
entries.natural: could you help me complete this form
entries.sourcePattern: xin vui lòng hỗ trợ tôi -> kindly + assist creates double formality layer; natural EN uses could you
entries.context: Please kindly assist me in completing this official form as I am not sure about several fields.

entries.vietlish: I respectfully submit my final report for your careful review
entries.natural: please find my final report attached
entries.sourcePattern: kính trình -> over-formal submission phrase from VN official language transferred to casual email
entries.context: I respectfully submit my final report for your careful review. Please let me know your thoughts.

entries.vietlish: thank you for your valuable time in reading this
entries.natural: thank you for reading this
entries.sourcePattern: cảm ơn bạn đã dành thời gian quý báu -> formal phrase from written VN overused in casual contexts
entries.context: She ended every text message with thank you for your valuable time in reading this.

entries.vietlish: I am regret to inform you that I cannot attend
entries.natural: I am sorry to inform you that I cannot attend
entries.sourcePattern: tôi tiếc phải thông báo -> am regret; regret used as adjective; English requires I regret or I am sorry
entries.context: I am regret to inform you that I cannot attend the conference due to a prior commitment.

entries.vietlish: I hope you have been doing well since our last meeting
entries.natural: how have you been
entries.sourcePattern: mong bạn mạnh khoẻ -> formal opener from Vietnamese letter-writing overused in every email
entries.context: She begins every email with I hope you have been doing well since our last meeting.

entries.vietlish: please rest assured that I will correct this error
entries.natural: I will fix this right away
entries.sourcePattern: xin yên tâm -> formal written-VN assurance phrase transferred to a casual chat message
entries.context: Please rest assured that I will correct this error by end of business today without fail.

entries.vietlish: with due respect, I would like to offer a different view
entries.natural: I respectfully disagree
entries.sourcePattern: với sự tôn trọng đầy đủ -> with due respect is awkward calque; I respectfully disagree is idiomatic
entries.context: With due respect, I would like to offer a different view on the solution proposed yesterday.

entries.vietlish: I would like to express my sincere gratitude for your support
entries.natural: thank you so much for your support
entries.sourcePattern: tôi muốn bày tỏ lòng biết ơn chân thành -> written-formal VN phrase inappropriate in a casual chat
entries.context: She typed I would like to express my sincere gratitude for your support in the team chat.

entries.vietlish: please do not hesitate to approach me for any assistance
entries.natural: feel free to ask if you need anything
entries.sourcePattern: đừng ngại liên hệ với tôi -> over-formal phrase from Vietnamese business letter used in casual messages
entries.context: She ended her class announcement with please do not hesitate to approach me for any assistance.

entries.vietlish: dear boss, I wish to request one day of annual leave tomorrow
entries.natural: hi [Name], could I take tomorrow off
entries.sourcePattern: kính gửi sếp -> formal letter register used in a workplace messaging app
entries.context: Dear boss, I wish to request one day of annual leave tomorrow for a personal matter.

entries.vietlish: the late submission was not my intention at all
entries.natural: I didn't mean to submit it late
entries.sourcePattern: việc nộp muộn không phải là ý định của tôi -> abstract nominalisation from written VN in casual apology
entries.context: The late submission was not my intention at all; my computer crashed the night before.

entries.vietlish: I am writing to seek your valuable advice regarding my career
entries.natural: could I ask your advice about my career
entries.sourcePattern: tôi viết để xin lời khuyên -> formal letter opening used in a direct verbal request to a friend
entries.context: I am writing to seek your valuable advice regarding my career prospects in marketing.

entries.vietlish: enclosed please find the completed application form
entries.natural: I have attached the completed application form
entries.sourcePattern: đính kèm theo đây -> archaic British business letter phrase still used by VN learners
entries.context: Enclosed please find the completed application form as requested in your earlier email.

entries.vietlish: I should be most grateful if you could reply by Friday
entries.natural: could you please reply by Friday
entries.sourcePattern: tôi sẽ rất biết ơn nếu bạn có thể -> over-formal conditional from Victorian English; use direct request
entries.context: I should be most grateful if you could reply by Friday so that we can confirm the venue.

entries.vietlish: thanking you in anticipation of your kind cooperation
entries.natural: thanks in advance
entries.sourcePattern: xin cảm ơn trước sự hợp tác của bạn -> formulaic closing from formal VN letters used in informal messages
entries.context: She always closes her emails with thanking you in anticipation of your kind cooperation.
